sloka: ततो मायां प्रविष्टो ऽसौ राक्षसीं राक्षसेश्वरः ।रूपाणां शतसाहस्रं विनाशाय चकार च ।। ७.१५.३२ ॥
transliteration: tato māyāṁ praviṣṭo 'sau rākṣasīṁ rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।rūpāṇāṁ śatasāhasraṁ vināśāya cakāra ca ।। 7.15.32 ॥

translations.english: Then, that lord of Rakshasas entered into a demonic illusion and created a hundred thousand forms for destruction.
